correctness.rationale: In characteristic two every radical element of A_q=F_q[x,y]/(x²,y²) squares to zero, so generator images are arbitrary in m and every unital endomorphism has six coefficients a,b,c,d,u,v. On m the matrix has bottom-right det L=ad+bc. The fixed dimension equals 4-rank(M-I_3); splitting determinant-one versus other and t=dim ker(L-I_2), then counting identity, q²-1 nontrivial unipotents, eigenvalue-one diagonalizable and remaining matrices gives all E_d and G_d distributions, including singular L. The dimension-three radical square vanishes, fixing its algebra type. The common-invariant jump follows from all translation functionals (u,v) and determinant action; Burnside sum gives 3q orbits. Independent F2/F4 exact GF linear-algebra enumeration tested all 2^6=64 and 4^6=4096 maps and found E2=(16,38,9,1), G2=(0,14,9,1); E4=(2176,1844,75,1), G4=(1280,1524,75,1).
residual_risks: Only powers of two and the specified four-dimensional unital algebra; no assertion for other monomial ideals or semilinear maps.

Those finer invariants cannot be derived from a known 3q orbit count alone and supply reusable finite-field algebra benchmarks.
